responsibility: Defines RTL machine-description support for CORE-V vendor extensions. It introduces the UNSPEC codes and instruction patterns for CORE-V ALU, event-load, SIMD arithmetic, shuffle/pack, comparison, complex, MAC, and branch forms, including immediate-vs-register alternatives and attribute typing, so that builtin expansion and generic RTL matching can emit the corresponding nonstandard CORE-V instructions on supported 32-bit targets.
same_name_distinction: Unlike corev.def, this file is the executable machine description for CORE-V support: it defines UNSPEC codes and define_insn RTL patterns such as cv.mac, cv.cmp*, and related forms that implement the instructions selected by the builtins table.
